target_moa.text: Ivosidenib is a small molecule inhibitor that targets the mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1) enzyme; susceptible IDH1 mutations lead to increased levels of 2-hydroxyglutarate (2-HG) in leukemia cells.

citations.quote: Ivosidenib is a small molecule inhibitor that targets the mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1) enzyme.
